reviewNotes: Historical (2024). ALDI launch batch, reviewed 2026-11-16 against the archived notice (dateline September 5, 2024). No Lotly agency case. FDA Enforcement Report lists Refresco Beverages US Inc apple juice recalls F-1746-2024 and F-1795-2024 (Class II, Terminated) for Great Value; whether either covers Nature's Nectar is not confirmed. The Best By column prints a date and a plant code together (MAR2625 CT89-4), so no Best By is approved.

fields.whatHappened: In cooperation with Refresco Beverages US Inc., ALDI recalled Nature’s Nectar 100% Apple Juice in select states.
fields.whyRecalled: The juice was recalled due to potential elevated levels of inorganic arsenic.
instructions: Throw the product away or return it to your local ALDI store for a full refund.
fields.contact: Call Refresco Beverages US Inc. at 1-888-260-3776.
